entries.title: Deuteronomy 29:1
segments: These [are] the words of the covenant which the LORD commanded Moses to make with the sons of Israel in the land of Moab, besides the covenant which He made with them in Horeb.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 29:2
segments: And Moses called to all Israel and said to them, You have seen all that the LORD did before your eyes in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh and to all his servants, and to all his land.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 29:3
segments: Your eyes have seen the great trials, the signs, and those great miracles.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 29:4
segments: Yet the LORD has not given you a heart to perceive, and eyes to see, and ears to hear, until today.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 29:5
segments: And I have led you forty years in the wilderness. Your clothes have not become old on you, and your shoe has not become old on your foot.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 29:6
segments: You have not eaten bread, neither have you drunk wine or strong drink, so that you might know that I [am] the LORD your God.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 29:7
segments: And when you came to this place, Sihon the king of Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, came out against us to battle, and we struck them.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 29:8
segments: And we took their land and gave it for an inheritance to the Reubenites and to the Gadites and to the half tribe of Manasseh.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 29:9
segments: Therefore, keep the words of this covenant and do them, so that you may act wisely in all that you do.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 29:10
segments: You stand today, all of you, before the LORD your God; your captains of your tribes, your elders, and your officers, all the men of Israel,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 29:11
segments: your little ones, your wives, and your stranger that [is] in your camp, from the cutter of your wood to the drawer of your water;

entries.title: Deuteronomy 29:12
segments: so that you should enter into covenant with the LORD your God, and into His oath, which the LORD your God makes you today;

entries.title: Deuteronomy 29:13
segments: that He may establish you today for a people to Himself, and [that] He may be a God to you, as He has said to you, and as He has sworn to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 29:14
segments: Nor do I make this covenant and this oath with you only,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 29:15
segments: but with [him] who stands here with us today before the LORD our God, and also with him that is not here with us today.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 29:16
segments: (For you know how we have lived in the land of Egypt, and how we came through the nations which you passed.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 29:17
segments: And you have seen their abominations and their idols, wood and stone, silver and gold, which [were] among them)

entries.title: Deuteronomy 29:18
segments: lest there should be among you man, or woman, or family, or tribe, whose heart turns away today from the LORD our God, to go serve the gods of these nations; lest there should be among you a root that bears gall and wormwood,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 29:19
segments: and it happens when he hears the words of this curse, that he shall bless himself in his heart, saying, I shall have peace, though I walk in the stubbornness of my heart, to snatch away the drunken with the thirsty.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 29:20
segments: The LORD will not be willing to forgive him, but then the anger of the LORD and His jealousy shall smoke against that man, and all the curses that are written in this book shall lie on him, and the LORD shall blot out his name from under heavens.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 29:21
segments: And the LORD shall set him apart to evil out of all the tribes of Israel, according to all the curses of the covenant that are written in this book of the law;

entries.title: Deuteronomy 29:22
segments: so that the generation to come of your sons that shall rise up after you, and the stranger that shall come from a far land, shall say (when they see the plagues of that land, and the sicknesses which the LORD has laid on it)

entries.title: Deuteronomy 29:23
segments: the whole land shall be burned [with] brimstone, and salt; it shall not be sown; nor shall it sprout; nor shall there be any grass in it. It [shall be] like the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboim, which the LORD overthrew in His anger, and in His wrath,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 29:24
segments: even all nations shall say, Why has the LORD done this to this land? [For] what [is] the heat of this great anger?

entries.title: Deuteronomy 29:25
segments: Then [men] shall say, Because they have forsaken the covenant of the LORD God of their fathers, which He made with them when He brought them forth out of the land of Egypt.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 29:26
segments: For they went and served other gods, and worshiped them, gods whom they did not know, and who had not given to them any portion.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 29:27
segments: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against this land, to bring on it all the curses that are written in this book.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 29:28
segments: And the LORD rooted them out of their land in anger and wrath, and in great indignation, and cast them into another land, as [it is] today.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 29:29
segments: The secret things [belong] to the LORD our God, but the revealed things [belong] to us and to our sons forever, so that we may do all the words of this law.
